interpretation: Historical reanalysis of an existing study, not a newly blind final test. November 2026 outcomes are diagnosis only.
focus_selection_rule: Among policies with >=70% fixture focus coverage, highest focus accuracy; ties favor higher coverage then alphabetical ID. Retain all candidate scores.
ties: Within 1e-12 means no directional pick; focus probability ties use 1x2, btts, total_2_5.
hybrid_rule: Only retain main published directions supported by the calibrated numerical model and the selected threshold. Preserve original main focus when eligible; otherwise apply the frozen focus policy to eligible main picks. Never introduce a main observation as a new main pick.
quality_gates: Reject future or conflicting history, non-90m scores, invalid probabilities, duplicate fixture IDs and unknown team/competition.
A live forecast requires explicit pre-cutoff current-history completeness audit per team; absent audit means observation.
Calibrated target marginals are not one joint score distribution. MC scenarios are raw and labeled per recipe.
Results stay outside forecast input; live recording refuses a past kickoff or existing output.
sensitivity: Report raw last-five leave-one-unique-match-out direction flips and range, including extreme scores; do not delete the score, fit new coefficients, or claim a statistical confidence interval.
mc_role: Diagnostics only. Choices come from calibrated analytical probabilities, not simulation noise.
mc_seed: First 16 hex digits of SHA256(model_version + colon + match_id + colon + recipe_id).
prospective_rule: Keep main and beta-v1 original scores; beta-v2 and hybrid get separate snapshots and denominators. No promotion from a posthoc score or synthetic test.
